failure_mode: A session that an agent drives as a sequence of steps commits funds or communicates with a third party in the name of the user.
cause: The account of the session can send, and the agent sends, by its own choice or because a page that it reads tells it to.
effect: An act that REQ-PL-013 gates occurs with no answer of the user, and nobody can reverse it.

failure_mode: The credential of a removed connection still works at the service.
cause: The system removes the credential from the host and does not revoke it.
effect: A copy of the credential that left the platform still reaches the account of the user.

failure_mode: The system keeps a copy away from the host for longer than the period that the platform keeps copies.
cause: The system does not remove the copies older than the period.
effect: Data that the user removed stays in a copy, and a restoration brings it back.

cause: A credential passes through an agent, is written in the record of a call, or is held by a part that reaches a service outside the system.
effect: Whoever reads it acts as the user at the service.

failure_mode: The copy away from the host cannot be read after the loss of the host.
cause: The key is held only on the host.
effect: REQ-PL-022 fails at the one time that it is needed. A restoration test on the host passes, because it uses the key of the host.

failure_mode: A person who reaches the location away from the host reads life state.
cause: The copy is held in a form that any reader can read.
effect: All of life state is exposed.

failure_mode: The system carries a call to an operation whose description changed after the act that uses it was declared.
cause: The service changes the operation and keeps its form.
effect: The call does something other than what the user approved.

failure_mode: A credential gives more access than its connection states.
cause: The consent asks for more than the declared scopes, and the user consents.
effect: The platform holds access that no declaration states.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a wrong answer back.

failure_mode: The system repeats a call that had its effect.
cause: The connection or the service fails after the effect, and a part of the system repeats the call by default.
effect: An act on the outside world occurs two times, and nobody can reverse it.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks at the external service.

failure_mode: A copy that a holder gave does not arrive at the location away from the host.
cause: The location is full or does not answer, or its credential stopped being valid.
effect: The restoration test restores an old copy and passes, and the loss of the host loses what came after it.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks.

failure_mode: The system accepts a delivery that the service did not send.
cause: Anyone can send to the address that accepts a delivery.
effect: False data reaches life state, and an agent gives an answer that looks correct.

failure_mode: The system carries a call from a system that the design does not name.
cause: A path is added that goes around Actuation.
effect: An act on the outside world occurs with no classification and no record.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a wrong answer back.

failure_mode: A credential stops being valid and nobody is told.
cause: The credential expires, or the user changes a password.
effect: Acquisitions and acts that use the credential fail.
detection: A person sees it in a report that the person already reads.

failure_mode: The metered cost passes the limit of the month.
cause: An agent declares a paid service as not metered.
effect: The recurring cost is more than REQ-PL-020 permits.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks.

failure_mode: The system stops calls at the limit and the user is not told.
cause: Nothing raises work when the limit starts to refuse.
effect: Agents stop, and the user sees no reason.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks.

failure_mode: No call reaches an external service.
cause: The system does not run, and it is the one route (DEC-032).
effect: No agent works, because each call to a model stops.

failure_mode: A session that an agent drives can send on an account whose connection states that it cannot.
cause: The connection understates what the account can do.
effect: REQ-EX-026 does not stop a request that it does not know can send.

failure_mode: A connection names as a tool that only reads a tool that acts.
cause: The agent that declares the connection names the tool wrongly.
effect: The model provider acts at a service for a call, with no Actuation and no answer of the user.
